extraction_scope: worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism/phenotype adjudication from local XML/PDF/OA package; no worker-5 overclaim promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Temporin G perturbs C. albicans membrane permeability in source-reported Sytox Green and PI assays, but the paper frames this as preliminary and does not resolve a single molecular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin G against Candida albicans ATCC10231
mechanism_claims.limitations: Membrane perturbation is demonstrated phenotypically; exact membrane target or binding partner is not established.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Temporin G does not show direct ergosterol-binding behavior in the local ergosterol competition assay because the MIC did not increase with exogenous ergosterol.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin G against Candida albicans ATCC10231
mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative ergosterol result narrows the mechanism but does not identify the direct membrane target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Temporin G does not appear to interfere with fungal cell-wall synthesis in the sorbitol protection assay; caspofungin behaves as the positive-control comparator.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin G against Candida albicans ATCC10231
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay is a cell-wall-involvement screen; it does not exclude all indirect wall-related effects.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Temporin G reduces C. albicans virulence-associated phenotypes including yeast-mycelial switching and biofilm formation/mature biofilm activity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin G against Candida albicans ATCC10231
mechanism_claims.limitations: Virulence-factor phenotypes are activity outcomes, not a resolved molecular mechanism.

mechanism_summary: Membrane perturbation is source-supported, ergosterol binding and cell-wall synthesis involvement are not supported by the local assays, and virulence-factor effects are preserved as phenotype-level activity claims.
